text:
erin: Quick sync takeaways from today's vendor onramp call. Need a single owner for the announcement cadence and a fallback routing plan.
jas: noted. who wants owner? happy to own marketplace gating if nobody else.
simon: I'll own SI rebuild coordination for Gaudi + MI300. Need integrator lead list.
li: perf flag: H100 microcode still in soak. vendor said +/- 10 days. If that slips, we should not show public perf numbers.
vendor-bot: Vendor bulletin: H100 microcode soak extended 10 days; Gaudi driver RC stable in partner tests; MI300 APAC cert pending signature (link: https://vendor.example/notes).
erin: constraints: marketing needs 8 business days notice for co-announcement and SKU + driver hash 10 calendar days before marketplace publish.
jas: propose flow: 1) publish partner-only early access w/ pinned hashes 2) run SI dry-runs 3) public announce after vendor GA + e2e pass.
simon: timeline suggestion:
- 2024-07-22: partner-only early access (pinned images)
- 2024-07-24: SI dry-run window (Gaudi)
- 2024-08-03: marketplace SKU freeze if vendor GA confirmed
- 2024-08-12: target public announce (subject to GA)
li: fallback mapping suggestion: H100 -> prefer [h200-prod, b200-q8] when microcode_unverified=true OR p99>200ms
jas: marketing asks we include a short fallback blurb: "Initial availability may be limited; full public rollout pending final vendor validation." marketing-bot: Draft message created in drive -> /partners/announcements/drafts/fallback-paragraph.md
erin: SI note: Gaudi driver RC has ABI change; simon please coordinate an automated CI rebuild job and a smoke test suite.
simon: will create CI job to rebuild images on RC publish. ETA 48h to configure. Will ping integrator leads.
vendor-bot: Reminder: MI300 APAC compliance docs due 2024-07-21 for marketplace listing.
li: EU/regulatory note: private deploys may need extra residency checks; add +3 business days to EU timelines.
jas: action items:
- jas: own marketplace gating + publish partner-only plan (due 2024-07-20)
- simon: SI rebuild CI + dry-run slots (due 2024-07-19)
- erin: coordinate vendor PMs for GA confirmation and microcode attestation (ongoing)
- li: perf gating criteria + fallback rules (due 2024-07-18)
marketing-bot: Embargo lead time reminder set for 8bd on 2024-07-31 if announce target 2024-08-12.
erin: any objections to soft-launch plan? small partner-only window reduces risk and gives integrators time.
simon: no objections. integrator leads need email today.
jas: I'll draft partner-only invite and pinned hashes.
erin: Great. I'll update the partners timeline doc and tag owners. Closing thread 44d
